name: oss-issue-proof
description: Codex-first evidence and verification receipts for open-source maintenance.

interface.longDescription: On supported Windows 10/11 hosts, import explicit Codex JSONL traces, compare baseline and independent verification evidence, and create redacted draft receipts without GitHub writes. Linux and macOS are unsupported, untested, and unverified.
defaultPrompt: Help me reproduce an OSS issue, import a Codex trace, independently verify the fix, and draft a maintenance receipt.
